brief: ArtLink 打通地基与数据层（P0 + P1）：修假绿灯、九个 migration 带 RLS、13 条访问规则测试
note: omc binary not installed on kepler-vps; this plan.json + ledger.jsonl emulate `omc ultragoal create-goals --plan-id artlink-p0p1`. Single aggregate Claude /goal covers the run. Shell cannot mutate /goal state; active agent must set/confirm it in-session per handoff.
